Chargesheet filed in J&K Bank loan fraud case

The Crime Branch has filed a chargesheet against a former daily wager of the Jammu and Kashmir Bank in connection with a loan fraud amounting to ₹1.04 crore. The case involves allegations of financial irregularities and misuse of funds within the bank.
